notes: A huge stage with a lighting rig, giant screens and smoke, confirmed as a modern festival main stage with an audience area in front, is Entertainment's Performance Venue on venue-stage — the one shape where the crowd faces a single direction and every sightline converges on the stage, which landmark-focal would lose. social-hub is that audience floor, kept as an open standing area because the author asked for a simple one with no defined capacity, and spawn-first-reveal puts arrivals facing the stage. I dropped the preset's spectator-bleachers for the same reason: raked seating would add tiered elevation the answer explicitly declined. Deciding without a user, I treated the lighting rig, screens, smoke and music as stage dressing carried in the build rather than options, and placed the interactive control console at the side of the stage as the answer specified — no option covers a player-operated console, so it needs to survive as a stated request. Everyone walks here, so this is an ordinary walkable P0 build, not a SET.
